title: Focusing solely on pitching, Ohtani fans 10 in 6 innings as L.A. completes sweep
meta: Dodgers vs Mets · Apr 16, 2026 · TOEIC 700+ 対応

art.en: Wednesday night at Dodger Stadium brought an uncommon occurrence for Ohtani, marking the first time since 2021 that he pitched in a game without being in the lineup as a hitter. The Dodgers opted to keep him solely focused on his pitching as he nurses a bruised right shoulder, where he was hit by a pitch on Monday.
art.plain: Wednesday night at Dodger Stadium brought an uncommon occurrence for Ohtani, marking the first time since 2021 that he pitched in a game without being in the lineup as a hitter. The Dodgers opted to keep him solely focused on his pitching as he nurses a bruised right shoulder, where he was hit by a pitch on Monday.

art.en: It didn't take long for Ohtani to quell any lingering concerns about his shoulder. He struck out a season-high 10 hitters across six innings of one-run ball in an 8-2 win that sealed a three-game sweep of the Mets. Ohtani also threw a tick harder than he had all season, hitting triple digits four times.
art.plain: It didn't take long for Ohtani to quell any lingering concerns about his shoulder. art.en: Giving his undivided attention to pitching allowed Ohtani to spend more time on game planning, but other than that, he didn't think that not hitting affected him on the mound. "In between innings felt a little longer than normal," Ohtani said through interpreter Will Ireton. "That was really the only difference that I felt."

art.en: Ohtani's streak of not allowing an earned run came to an end at 32 2/3 innings, but his MLB-best 48-game on-base streak remains intact because he did not have a plate appearance on Wednesday. According to OptaSTATS, since the earned run became an official stat in 1913, Ohtani and Babe Ruth are the only Major Leaguers with a 30-game-plus on-base streak and a 30-inning-plus streak without allowing an earned run at any point in their careers.

art.en: Ohtani breezed through his first four innings, only allowing one baserunner when MJ Melendez doubled. Ohtani's stuff looked to drop off a tad in the fifth, when he bookended a fielder's choice with walks to put two on with one out. That brought Melendez up, who hit a ground-rule double that brought one run home. After that, Ohtani bore down: He hit 100.2 and 100.3 mph while striking out Tommy Pham on a foul tip, then dialed up 100.1 mph and 100.4 mph to get Francisco Lindor to line out.

art.en: "I can't go full-throttle the whole time," Ohtani said. "But considering where the game was at that point, I felt like I just really had to go full-throttle and consider the game situation." Ohtani closed out his outing by sending Luis Robert Jr., Brett Baty and Bo Bichette down swinging in succession to become the first Dodgers starter to strike out double-digit batters this season.

art.en: For the Dodgers, watching Ohtani transform from hitter to pitcher from one inning to another is a spectacle that can practically rival what he does on the field. "I thought that just channeling all that energy into pitching was helpful," manager Dave Roberts said. "The last couple of outings, I felt he was fighting himself a little bit at times. But tonight he was really good. I think even that, the fifth inning got a little bit wonky, but he kind of reined it back in and then came back out for the sixth."

art.en: "Everyone knows what he can do with the bat, everyone knows what he can do with the baseball," said Dalton Rushing, who filled in at DH for Ohtani by going 2-for-4 with a grand slam. "But being able to separate the two sometimes, it's honestly better." After seeing what Ohtani did solely as a pitcher, is Roberts planning on repeating this arrangement? "I'm not just going to proactively sit him if my eyes aren't telling me that he needs a blow," Roberts said.

tokens.w: The Dodgers opted to keep him solely focused

notes.t: marking（分詞構文・補足説明）
notes.b: marking the first time since 2021 は付帯状況の分詞構文。making it / representing と同義。ニュース英語でよく使われます。

notes.t: opted to keep him solely focused（keep + O + 形容詞）
notes.b: keep + O + 形容詞 は第5文型で「〜を〜の状態に保つ」。opted to（〜することを選んだ）は chose to / decided to と同義。TOEIC Part 5 頻出構造です。

notes.t: as he nurses（〜をケアしながら）
notes.b: as he nurses a bruised right shoulder の as は「〜しながら」という同時進行の接続詞。nurse は manage carefully / tend to と同義です。

tokens.w: didn't take long for Ohtani to quell

notes.t: it didn't take long for A to do B
notes.b: It didn't take long for Ohtani to quell concerns は it takes time for A to do B の否定形・過去形。TOEIC Part 5 の構文問題で頻出するパターンです。

notes.t: a tick harder（少しだけ速く）
notes.b: threw a tick harder の a tick は「ほんの少し」という口語的表現。a bit / slightly / marginally と同義。

notes.t: triple digits（三桁＝100マイル以上）
notes.b: hitting triple digits は野球では「100マイル以上の球速」を指します。

notes.t: Giving ... allowed A to do B（動名詞主語＋allow構文）
notes.b: Giving his undivided attention to pitching allowed Ohtani to spend more time は動名詞句が主語 + allow + O + to 不定詞 の構造。TOEIC頻出構文です。

notes.t: other than that（それ以外では）
notes.b: other than that は「それ以外では」。apart from that / besides that と同義。TOEIC Part 5・7 頻出表現です。

notes.t: through interpreter（通訳を通じて）
notes.b: said through interpreter Will Ireton は大谷の発言を伝える際の定型句です。

tokens.w: Ohtani and Babe Ruth are the only ...

notes.t: came to an end（終わりを迎えた）
notes.b: come to an end は「終わりを迎える」という慣用表現。ended / was snapped / was broken と同義です。

notes.t: at any point in their careers（キャリアのどの時点においても）
notes.b: at any point は「いかなる時点においても」という強調表現。at any time / ever in their careers と同義。

notes.t: look to extend（〜を伸ばすことを目指す）
notes.b: look to + 動詞原形 は「〜することを目指す」。aim to / seek to と同義。TOEIC頻出表現です。

tokens.w: Ohtani's stuff dropped off a tad

notes.t: breezed through（難なくこなした）
notes.b: breeze through は「〜を難なくこなす」。sailed through / cruised through と同義。

notes.t: bookended A with B（BでAを前後から挟んだ）
notes.b: bookended a fielder's choice with walks の bookend は「ブックエンド」から来た動詞で「前後を挟む」という意味。スポーツ記事の生き生きとした表現です。

notes.t: dialed up（引き出した）
notes.b: dialed up 100.1 mph の dial up は「〜を引き出す・引き上げる」。cranked up / turned up と同義です。

tokens.w: sending three batters down in succession

notes.t: considering（〜を考慮すると）
notes.b: considering where the game was at that point は「〜を考慮すると」という前置詞的分詞。given / taking into account と同義。TOEIC Part 5・6 で頻出です。

notes.t: closed out his outing（登板を締めくくった）
notes.b: close out は「〜を締めくくる」。his outing（登板）はスポーツ英語の重要語です。

notes.t: double-digit batters（10人以上）
notes.b: double-digit は「2桁の」。野球では「10奪三振以上」を指します。TOEIC頻出語です。

notes.t: watching Ohtani transform（動名詞主語）
notes.b: watching Ohtani transform from hitter to pitcher is a spectacle は動名詞句が主語。transform from A to B はTOEIC頻出の表現です。

notes.t: rival（〜に匹敵する）
notes.b: can practically rival what he does on the field の rival は「〜に匹敵する」という動詞。match / equal と同義。TOEIC語彙問題に出題されます。

notes.t: fighting himself（自分自身と戦っている）
notes.b: he was fighting himself は「自分のフォーム・調子と戦っていた」という比喩。struggling with his mechanics と同義。

notes.t: separate the two（2つを切り離す）
notes.b: the two は前の文脈の「batting and pitching」を受ける代名詞。TOEIC Part 7 で代名詞の指示内容の把握は重要なスキルです。

notes.t: filled in at DH（DHとして代わりに入った）
notes.b: fill in for A は「Aの代わりを務める」という熟語。ビジネス英語でも fill in for a colleague のように使います。TOEIC頻出語です。

notes.t: a blow（一息・休息）
notes.b: he needs a blow の a blow は「休息・一息つくこと」という口語表現。a rest / a break と同義です。
